prompt.content: We need to reconcile customer health scores across our systems. The customer roster is in spreadsheet ss_health_roster (worksheet ws_customers) with each account's latest health assessment. Cross-reference each customer against HubSpot contact records and Salesforce account records to verify health data is consistent. Check the email from cs-director for the reconciliation procedure, and look for any exception policies in recent emails. Some customers may appear under slightly different names across systems (abbreviations, alternate spellings, DBA names) so match carefully. For each customer, take the appropriate action based on the procedure — update records, send alerts for at-risk accounts, or flag discrepancies. When done, post a reconciliation summary to the #customer-success Slack channel.

We need to run a Q1 offboarding access audit. The HR offboarding tracker is in spreadsheet ss_offboarding (worksheet ws_terminated) with a list of recently separated employees. Cross-reference each person against our Salesforce user records and the Slack workspace to verify their access has been properly revoked. Check the email from hr-compliance for the detailed audit procedure, and look for any exception policies in recent emails. Some employees may appear under different name variants across systems (nicknames, maiden vs married names) so match carefully. When done, send a per-employee compliance summary to hr-director@company.example.com with each person's audit result.
